profile.name: Trafalgar Law

reasons.reason: Capturar tesouro ativa traits. O perfil considera esse benefício além da classe.

evidence.text: When you instantly capture the Treasure: Uses 5 unit(s) of the Power Gauge. and Increase the Treasure Gauge amount when you capture Treasure.
When you capture the Treasure: Recover HP by 30%. and Reduce the cooldown time of Skill 1 by 30%.

profile.confidence: perfil com regras de traits reconhecidas

unmodeled.text: Can ignore the enemy and capture the Treasure. and 1 HP will be left even if KO'd (ineffective if HP is exactly 1).
When you are in your enemy's Treasure Area and the Treasure Gauge is 50% or more: Boost capture speed by 100%.

Power Gauge can be used (increases up to 5, but resets once KO'd). and Trait Instant Capture Possible icon will appear on any enemy Treasure Areas that have 30% or less of their Treasure Gauge remaining.
When counter succeeds: Boosts Power Gauge by 2. and Recover HP by 30%.
Every time you continually lower the enemy's Treasure Gauge by 20%: Boosts Power Gauge by 1. and Increase DEF by 15% (increases up to 50% but resets once KO'd).
When the Power Gauge is at max and the Treasure Gauge of the Treasure Area you are capturing is 30% or less: Ignore Treasure Area transformation effects and instantly capture the Treasure.
When in the Treasure Area: Nullify immobilizing status effects inflicted by enemy. and Resist Stagger and being Downed.
When attacking an enemy with a skill: 50% recovery of damage given (up to 7500). and Nullify the Trait "1 HP will be left even if KO'd".
When attacked by an enemy with the Element you are strong against: Nullify Max HP Reduction. and Recover 50% of percentage damage received from an enemy.
When attacked by an enemy using a skill: Reduce damage received by 50%. and Reduce the cooldown time of Skill 2 by 10%.
When attacked by a character type "Navy" enemy: Remove enemy's ATK increase. and Recover HP by 5%.

limitations: Pesos e fatores são heurísticos, não oficiais nem medidos em partidas.
Não simula dano final, evolução de skills, mapas, inimigos, troca de classe ou todos os traits.
Traits adicionais não estão equipados neste ranking. Recomendações de atributos são separadas.
Condições usam os fatores gerais 0,5 e 0,25; o cenário real pode mudar a ordem.
Os cinco sets podem compartilhar medalhas: não se força diversidade à custa da pontuação.
